descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使吃旧金山酸面包后画的菜单，口感旁边留着停顿。
descriptions.en: A menu after San Francisco sourdough, with a pause beside its texture notes.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在旧金山记录自己那碗番茄海鲜汤的小菜单。
descriptions.en: A little record of the messenger’s own San Francisco cioppino.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 自写的金门大桥颜色名便签，两行用圈连起来。
descriptions.en: A homemade bridge-colour note joining two lines with a circle.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 旧金山午饭后自制的小纸，只有写下的香味记忆。
descriptions.en: A homemade paper carrying words about a San Francisco lunch, rather than the soup.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使离开旧金山缆车博物馆后整理的原创箭头草稿。
descriptions.en: An original arrow draft sorted out after leaving the Cable Car Museum.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使亲手制作的长纸签，写金门大桥颜色名，非标准色样。
descriptions.en: A handmade long paper label for the bridge colour’s name, not a standard swatch.
